Name: Selected Measure
Expression:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE(MeasureSelector[MeasureIndex]),
    0, [Adjustment $ to Inventory $],
    1, [Adjustment Qty to Inventory Qty],
    2, [Adjustment Lines to Inventory Lines],
    BLANK()
)

Name: Selected Adjustment $ (R12)
Expression:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE(AdjustmentTypes[AdjustmentType]),
    "Positive Adjustment $ (R12)", [Positive Adjustment $ (R12)],
    "Negative Adjustment $ (R12)", [Negative Adjustment $ (R12)],
    BLANK()
)

Name: Total Adjustment Lines (R12)
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS(InTrans_Parts_Adjust),
    DATESINPERIOD(
        InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Trans_Date],
        LASTDATE(InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Trans_Date]),
        -12,
        MONTH
    ),
    InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Qty] <> 0
)

Name: Negative Adjustment Lines (R12)
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    -1 * COUNTROWS(InTrans_Parts_Adjust),
    DATESINPERIOD(
        InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Trans_Date],
        LASTDATE(InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Trans_Date]),
        -12,
        MONTH
    ),
    InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Qty] < 0
)

Name: Positive Adjustment Lines (R12)
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS(InTrans_Parts_Adjust),
    DATESINPERIOD(
        InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Trans_Date],
        LASTDATE(InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Trans_Date]),
        -12,
        MONTH
    ),
    InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Qty] > 0
)
